$comment: Checked-in collision decisions for the cross-tier ownership map (TASK-OSS-P0-02). A collision is NEVER auto-resolved: until a maintainer records one here, `generate:ownership:map` exits non-zero and the symbol resolves to null. Each decision must name an ADR — the point of the file is that the reasoning is reviewable, not that the build goes green. Empty is the correct state while no Core/Pro name collides (verified 2026-08-20: zero overlapping symbols between Core @ be76ddb and Pro @ origin/main).

DzButton.rationale: one sentence a reviewer can check
